intro: The Rite of Vision is a foundational spiritual trial undergone by young tauren stepping beyond the Red Cloud Mesa into greater Mulgore. To pierce the veil and receive guidance from ancestral spirits, initiates must gather natural reagents to brew the Water of the Seers under the watchful eye of Zarlman Two-Moons in Bloodhoof Village.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: In order to pass through the Rite of Vision, you must gather the reagents needed to make the Water of the Seers.
I will need well stones, which can be found around the water wells in Mulgore. With those I will combine Ambercorn, which fall beneath the mighty trees in our land.

These reagents contain magical elements, and when brewed and consumed before the tribal fire, will cause you to encounter a vision. Follow it, and it will lead you to the next step of this holy quest.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Once you have gathered enough well stones from around the water wells and Ambercorn from beneath the trees, I will prepare the Water of the Seers for you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I see you have learned to gather from our sacred land, friend. It will take but a moment for me to brew the Water of the Seers.
